svg.desc: The route so far. NOW: AI-NATIVE, Agent harnesses · MCP · skills · AI governance. AI-native across the lifecycle: spec, design, code, review, release. I build agent harnesses, MCP servers, skills, agents and the governance that keeps code agents secure and confidential, and I run corporate AI trainings. Three mission systems · NestJS, React, Oracle, OpenShift EXIT 2025: CELSIA, Senior integration developer. App Connect to Quarkus, Camel and Kafka on Kubernetes EXIT 2024: QUIND, Technical lead. Flypass tolls and parking · Spring Boot, Kafka, CQRS, AWS · -40% time-to-market EXIT 2023: OLJ SOLUTIONS, Senior software developer. IP/REV tolls and RUNT · Ministry of Transport EXIT 2021: INDRA, Technical lead. Banco de la República · two teams of four · -98% latency, 5 s to 100 ms EXIT 2020: FREELANCE, Architect and developer.
